value.rationale: Wovenness is a universal over measurable partitions, whereas Parseval normalization lets the worst-case partition be eliminated exactly via total variation of the measurement distributions. The resulting scalar invariant equals the supremum operator norm of partial frame-operator differences, detects robust weaving iff tau<1, provides sharp optimal universal energy bounds, and quantifies the entire robustness interval despite identical global frame operators. This is a natural measurement-overlap classification, not an arbitrary isolated example.
